Notes: Unicorn Recruiter. Captured by LiveCapture in Unicorn Outpost (4364) at (151.7, 100.9, 164.4). Nearest HashSpawnPoint UIRC at (151.7, 101.3, 164.4), 0.4m away. Rolls the Alien Mothership mission 829N (a Quests.json dungeon quest in ACG style 386 behind the outpost's Alien Mothership entrance) at the mission quality the line names, from the captured live multipliers of the top monster level: take it easy = level+2% (easy), handle our business = level+12% (medium), too chicken = level+53% (hard). The quest puts ordinary mobs 5% under that and the MJ9O boss at it. Each give rolls a fresh dungeon. Replies that give the mission are hidden while it is active; the captured no-give line 7 shows instead.
